title: BJP Minister's Son Booked Under POCSO in Telangana
excerpt: Bandi Sai Bageerath faces sexual assault FIR as rival complaint alleges honey-trap, extortion by the girl's family
body:
A Telangana court controversy exploded into national headlines this week after police registered a POCSO case against Bandi Sai Bageerath, son of Union Minister of State for Home Affairs Bandi Sanjay Kumar, on May 8, 2026. The case, filed at Pet Basheerabad Police Station in Hyderabad, has split political opinion sharply — and left investigators navigating two fiercely contested versions of events.

**What the FIR alleges:**
The complainant, a girl aged approximately 17, told police she was made to consume alcohol and sexually assaulted at a farmhouse on the outskirts of Hyderabad on two separate occasions. Her mother's formal complaint, submitted to the court, cited a sustained pattern of 'grooming, emotional manipulation and sexual exploitation' allegedly dating back to June 2025. The FIR invokes Sections 74 and 75 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and Sections 11 and 12 of the POCSO Act — provisions that treat consent by a minor as legally immaterial.

**The counter-complaint and political fallout:**
On the same day the POCSO case was registered, Bageerath filed his own complaint at Karimnagar's Two Town Police Station, naming the minor girl and her parents and accusing them of intimidation and extortion of up to Rs 3 crore. His family's PRO described the case as an orchestrated honey-trap. BRS leader K.T. Rama Rao rejected that framing outright, condemning the filing of counter-cases against the complainant herself and raising alarm that the minor had allegedly attempted suicide twice during the ordeal. No arrests have been confirmed, and both BJP and the ruling Telangana Congress face pressure over their handling of the case.

**What to watch:**
With a multi-angle police investigation underway and senior opposition leaders demanding Bandi Sanjay Kumar's resignation, the next 72 hours will determine whether arrests follow — and whether the Union Minister retains his cabinet post.
